C1804.title: Guangzhou Police Busts National "Blind-Shipping" Cash-on-Delivery Fraud Ring
C1804.summary: In January 2022, Guangzhou police traced a 69-yuan COD parcel case and busted three national "blind-shipping" fraud rings, arresting 23 suspects with over 20 million yuan involved. The rings obtained names, phone numbers, and addresses of more than 300,000 victims via illegal channels, randomly shipping low-value counterfeit goods cash-on-delivery and collecting payment upon recipient sign-off.
